description: Configuration panel assets before the signalk-nearlcrews-ui migration
approval: Recalibrated for the signalk-nearlcrews-ui 0.8.0 upgrade, which measured 33590 gzip bytes. The 0.8.0 additions that grew the panel are runtime popover-trigger and labelable-control validation, the panel-contained toast viewport host, and viewport-bottom action-bar focus preservation. The prior 33000-byte ceiling covered the 0.7.0 migration: the viewport action bar, secret input, compatibility notice, and relative-age helper integrations.
